case_name: Smt. Neelu Kohli vs Naveen Kohli
facts_of_case: The wife filed a suit for divorce and annulment of marriage under Section 13 of the Hindu Marriage Act. The husband claimed that the wife was a woman of hard temperament and rude behaviour, and had been picking up quarrels with him and his parents. He alleged that she was cunning and had trapped him in such a way that he was forced to live separately from her.

legal_principles.principle: A spouse's social status and acquired wealth do not justify ignoring family responsibilities.
legal_principles.held: band ignoring his responsibility toward his wife and his children and social status which he had come to acquire for whatever reasons, had chosen a wrong path at that stage which did not behove well of him and was not in the interest of the family peace.

legal_principles.principle: A spouse's business dealings and financial situation can be considered in determining alimony.
legal_principles.held: It was also alleged that out of the aforesaid 4 business concerns, the husband had unlawfully and by force and by violence had grabbed and had taken full control of three of them and only M/s. Nitin Rubber Company was the company being run in the supervision and control of the wife.

outcome.final_order: The decree of annulment of marriage will come into effect on the payment of a lump sum amount of Rs. 5 lacs to the wife towards maintenance allowance to her.
